_about: The Golden Legend of Jacobus de Voragine (c. 1230-1298), the medieval book of saints' lives, in William Caxton's English of 1483, edited by F. S. Ellis for the Temple Classics (London: J. M. Dent, 1900), all seven volumes. Caxton is the translator ("englished by William Caxton"). Raw Internet Archive OCR. Public domain. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto). Every volume's title page was read in the OCR: all seven are the Temple Classics 1900 set ('Edited by F. S. Ellis'; vols. 5-7 OCR the word ENGLISHED as 'ENGLISHEI', which is why the fetch's title-word check flagged them).
